response.sql: WITH scope_stats AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, avg_net_fee_rate, row_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS deviation_from_mean_of_scope_averages FROM scope_stats
